sheet.p: Please review how Twilio Call Auto Dialer works with your Twilio account, how your data is handled, and our fair usage policy.

div.p: Twilio Call Auto Dialer connects exclusively to your own Twilio account. You must provide your Twilio Account SID, Auth Token, and phone number. All voice calls and messaging are executed through Twilio under your account and are billed by Twilio according to their published rates.

This module does not provide telephony minutes, phone numbers, or Twilio credit. You remain solely responsible for maintaining a valid Twilio account, sufficient balance, and compliance with Twilio’s terms of service and local telecommunications regulations.

The software provides an Odoo interface for softphone calling, Auto Dialer campaigns, contact click-to-call, local call logs, and optional AI transcription features. Availability of optional features may depend on your configuration and applicable usage limits.

You agree to use this module only for lawful business communication. You must not use the dialer for spam, harassment, unsolicited bulk calling, or any activity prohibited by law or by Twilio’s Acceptable Use Policy.

The software is provided as-is. We do not guarantee uninterrupted calling, carrier connectivity, or third-party AI service availability. Call quality and delivery depend on Twilio, your network, and end-user devices.
Your contact records, call logs, campaign lists, transcripts, and configuration are stored in your Odoo database. We do not operate a separate backend that collects or hosts your CRM or call data.

Twilio credentials (Account SID, Auth Token, API keys) are stored in your Odoo system parameters / configuration. You control access through Odoo user permissions and security groups. We recommend restricting Configuration access to trusted administrators only.

Call audio and signaling are processed by Twilio under your Twilio account. If you enable AI transcription or summaries, recordings or related content may be sent to the AI provider you configure (for example OpenAI). Those services are governed by their own privacy policies and terms.
You are responsible for informing your users and customers about call recording or transcription where required by law, and for securing your Odoo instance, backups, and Twilio account access.
You retain ownership of your business data at all times. Removing the module does not transfer your data to us. You may export or delete records according to your Odoo administration practices.

Twilio Call Auto Dialer is currently offered free of charge for installation and core use within Odoo. There is no per-seat software license for the dialer interface while this free offering remains in effect.

To keep the service sustainable for all users, free usage is subject to a monthly fair-usage allowance. This initial free limit is intended for normal business evaluation and day-to-day light-to-moderate calling activity.

Fair usage covers reasonable call volume through the Odoo softphone, Auto Dialer campaigns, and related features under normal operating conditions. Excessive automated or high-volume activity that impacts platform stability may be throttled or require an upgrade.

If your team needs usage beyond the monthly free fair-usage limit, you can purchase add-ons through In-App Purchases inside Odoo Apps. Add-ons unlock higher monthly capacity and any premium feature packs announced for the module.

Twilio voice minutes remain separate and are always billed by Twilio on your own account (pay-as-you-go). In-App Purchases apply only to this module’s usage entitlements and software features, not to Twilio carrier charges.

We aim to keep billing clear: free core access, a defined monthly fair-usage ceiling, and optional paid add-ons for higher volume. Specific allowance amounts and add-on prices are published in the Odoo Apps product page and/or In-App Purchase listings and may be updated from time to time.
We may update these Terms, Privacy, or Fair Usage terms to reflect product changes or regulatory requirements. Continued use of the module after updates constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
